kevin: Heads up — noticed a spike in early-close events on SSE since the canary rollout. Console shows ~3.2k closed streams in 10m, but routing metrics don't show capacity pressure. Anyone seeing this? maria: yep saw it at 15:12 UTC. aligns with the route-affinity tweak (sticky -> least-loaded) we shipped. sam: repro'd locally: client gets 200 then socket 'close' (1006) after ~16s for long-poll responses. Seems like proxy idle timeout at ~15s is cutting them. kevin: the intent was keepalive=30s on the new pool. @ops-jen can you confirm proxy config for the canary pool? ops-jen: looking — terraform shows idle_keepalive = 15 on pool-a (old). pool-b (new) has 30, but router affinity bug sent canary traffic to pool-a. working on a rollback. :facepalm: maria: that explains it. console telemetry attributes to pool but per-route breakdown is coarse; can't easily see which routes hit pool-a vs pool-b. we need finer granularity. sam: also noticed access logs missing close code tag in many entries — we log stream close but not close_code, makes it hard to tell early-close vs client abort. kevin: proposal: 1) add close_code as a tag in proxy access log and emit a prometheus metric stream_close_total{code="",route="",pool="

"} 2) make retry heuristic exponential with jitter and a bounded fallback to WS after N attempts 3) gateway-level resume-token dedupe window to avoid double-processing resume on quick reconnects. maria: UX ask: rollout page should show canary vs baseline stream-close rates and a route-level keepalive column. right now rollout only surfaces 5xx and p50/p99 latency which misses streaming semantics. ops-jen: applied terraform change to set idle_keepalive=30 on pool-a and started rolling. will also pin canary back to pool-b after affinity fix. dev-bot: deploy started: terraform apply for proxy-pool-a @ 1719954345 sam: quick sanity check: after setting 30s, I repro again and close happens at ~31s — looks fixed for the keepalive. BUT clients' retry loops kick in and we observed duplicate billing events in telemetry (duplicate token resume caused reprocessing). need idempotency. kevin: add a resume-token dedupe at gateway for a 10s sliding window + emit an alert when duplicate_resume_rate > 0.1% traffic. this should stop billing dupes and be low-risk. maria: I'll draft a short PR: metrics + console tile + rollout change. checklist: accesslog close_code, prometheus metric, console tile for route/pool/canary, router-affinity fix, gateway resume dedupe. ops-jen: terraform finished, deploy completed @ 1719954380 sam: post-fix counts back to baseline in canary. leaving thread open for postmortem notes; will add repro steps and log snippets to the PR. kevin: thanks everyone. marking this P1 unless counts spike >5% traffic.
